articles.description:
#思考 #商业思维  人跟人真的不一样，三维：环境、圈子、认知 
这三维我就用一个问题让你秒懂： “你花1W块钱包养一个女大学生，能不能做到？” 
这个问题蛮招骂的，但这样问其实能更容易引起思考。  
注意，问题重点是 “能不能做到” 
如果你能做到，你需要思考一下：”对方为什么愿意“ 
很简单啊，因为你的世界和都对方的世界不一样，所以对方愿意。  
在对方的世界里边，觉得一个月能有一万块钱太牛逼了。 
在你的世界里边，觉得一个月能有一万块钱太垃圾了。  
懂我的意思么？那么如何赚钱？  就利用上述所说的，信息差、认知差赚钱就好了。  
这个世界，所有生意，都围绕这几点罢了，无论什么生意，都脱离不了！ 
那么如何去探寻认知差、信息差？  通过三维就可以，说个最容易理解的：“我不会配电脑，那么如果你会DIY电脑” 
你与我之间就存在了认知差、信息差，那么这就存在变现机会。  
牛逼的人只是把这个机会扩大化，SOP化，流程化了而已
🤦 我做过信息差最大的一件事： 给一个人分享了一个VPN软件，他转了我 2000 USDT ， 表示非常感谢🙏
还比如，抖音上有教成人“拼音”“汉字”的账号... 
说自己啥都不会，是你没想明白而已。

RT BitHappy
一个币本位稳赚，但 U 本位有风险的机会！
此策略针对 Shadow 的 x(3,3) 机制。
➤ 已知：
1）x33 是使用 xSHADOW 铸造的收益复合型流动性质押代币，目前铸造比例为 0.658:1；
2）x33 可以赎回成 xSHADOW，xSHADOW 又可赎回成 SHADOW，但若立即赎回，将面临 50% 的惩罚；
3）同样，若直接卖出 x33，也会触发与立即赎回 xSHADOW 相同的 50% 惩罚机制；
4）xSHADOW 在等待六个月的赎回期后，可免受惩罚；
5）x33 代币可在市场上自由交易；
6）x33 与 xSHADOW 当前交易对比例为 1.314:1；  
➤ 策略：
我们可以通过直接购买 x33，然后将其赎回为 xSHADOW，再经过六个月的赎回期，最终获得 SHADOW 代币。
通过计算，此方法可得到约 1.314 / 0.658（当前铸造率）≈ 1.99 倍的 SHADOW 代币。
➤ 举例：
假设花费 1 个 SHADOW 购买 x33，可获得 1.314 个 x33。经过六个月的赎回期后，这 1.314 个 x33 可兑换成约 1.99 个 SHADOW。
➤ 风险与收益：  
如果是 SHADOW 本位，这个策略稳赚！  
但如果是 U 本位，则需注意：只有当币价下跌 (1.99 - 1) / 1.99 ≈ 49.74% 时才会出现亏损。

去中心化交易平台 Axiom 在过去 24 小时内创造了近 200 万美元的收入，使其超过了 http://pump.fun 和 Hyperliquid 。
🔗 立刻体验： https://axiom.trade/@0xcii 
Axiom 现在是整个 DeFi 中第三大收入来源，仅次于稳定币巨头 Tether ( $USDT ) 和 Circle ( $USDC )。 
据 DeFiLlama 数据，在 memecoin 市场回暖的推动下，该协议的 24 小时收入在过去两个月中增长了近 10倍，
Axiom 在 4 月 30 日的日收入创下了 200 万美元的历史新高，而 3 月 1 日仅为 254,000 美元。
Axiom 的费用和收入增加是由 MEME 市场推动的，因为 HOUSECOIN 等代币最终突破了 1 亿美元大关，而 GORK 这个新发行代币在几个小时内从接近零飙升至 6000 万美元。
得益于“MEME 季”，Axiom 和 http://pump.fun 等 memecoin 交易基础设施已成为现代 DeFi 中的强大力量，但也因将 SOL 等代币收取的费用， 出售为法定货币而受到批评。（流动性推出）
Axiom 成立于 2024 年，是一个由 Y-Combinator 支持的交易平台，其界面内聚合了现货交易、永续合约和质押收益。

RT L0la L33tz
If you, an unbiased person, take a look at this graphic by Elliptic, do you come to the conclusion that "unhosted wallets" are what enable cartels to launder money through cryptocurrencies?
Or could it be that the actual problem is that cartels still somehow manage to deposit their cash in the financial system, despite extensive AML/CFT frameworks imposed on banks?
And if these frameworks are already exploited by cartels, can you outline precisely how imposing these same AML/CFT regulations on "unhosted wallets" would stop cartels from exploiting them – and not just impose unproportionate burdens on the average user?
Given what Elliptic has outlined in their newest report, lawmakers should be extremely wary of relying on for-profit marketing materials to inform their decisions, and keep in mind that the expansion of AML/CFT frameworks to "unhosted wallets" would drastically enlarge such firms' addressable market, constituting a clear profit motive – while likely doing nothing to stop actual crime.

I don't see many offering alternatives to the Trump policy agenda with regards to fixing the income inequality but I still see many not understanding the why. This table might help explain. Since 2023, foreign born employment has grown >2x more than native born, despite the native born employment level being >4x the size.
Given the strong correlation between this data and border crossings, it is very clear in showing that illegal immigration and an open border policy has hurt lower and middle income American workers' competitive position in the labor market as well as hampered their wage growth. While this is both pro-growth and disinflationary, the benefits accrue to corporations via higher profits and the wealthy upper class via higher stock prices at the expense of the lower and middle class who suffer wage stagnation and low job growth.
If this strikes a chord with you, I would like to understand why as I have tried to write this as objectively and factual as possible. I don't know what the right answer is but I understand why there's a major class divide in the country and interest in change from large parts of the US population. The Trump policy agenda is simply implementing what they believe they have been elected to do.
